title.zh: 三组分子动力学山脊图

source_publication_note: The supplied screenshot collection did not identify a verified paper/DOI for each image.

provenance.zh: 按截图峰位 宽度 高度近似拟合的混合高斯轮廓；高度为绘图单位，非概率密度原值
provenance.en: Gaussian mixtures fitted approximately by eye to screenshot peak positions, widths and heights; not trajectory samples.

seed_note: Original example-generation session used NumPy seed 190913 across all figures; the seed alone does not reconstruct digitized/manual values. The committed CSVs and SHA-256 hashes define this snapshot.

zh: 分子动力学轨迹的 frame/time/replicate ID，以及每个帧的 Core RMSD、A-loop RMSD 和 Distance 1 Δ。
参考结构、原子选择、结构对齐方法、距离定义与 Å 单位。
0/8/12/16/20/24 ns 分组对应的时间窗与采样策略；不要把自相关帧当独立重复。
en: Frame/time/replicate IDs and per-frame Core RMSD, A-loop RMSD and Distance 1 Δ values.
Reference structure, atom selection, alignment procedure, distance definition and Å units.
Time windows and sampling scheme for the 0/8/12/16/20/24 ns groups; correlated frames are not independent replicates.

preprocessing.zh: 可直接提供 panel/group/value 样本长表，由程序估计 KDE；也可提供 x/density 曲线。峰高按展示高度归一化，不表示样本量。
preprocessing.en: Provide panel/group/value observations for automatic KDE, or x/density curves. Peak height is normalized for display and does not encode sample count.

description.zh: 分面编号或名称；与样式定义一致
实验组或细胞群；与样式一致
description.en: Experimental group or cell population; match style

description.zh: 已转换的横轴坐标；不是原始特征矩阵
description.en: Transformed x coordinate, not a raw feature matrix

description.zh: 分布的展示高度，不是样本量
description.en: Display height of a distribution, not sample count
